name: Kannan
role: Debt-bound bookkeeper in Nina Chatu’s brokerage
bio: Kannan keeps the cargo entries for Chatu’s brokerage and works under a debt agreement. He asks a fellow clerk to witness a repayment the creditor left off the account; his family’s future cannot depend on an erased line.
notes: fact: Melaka’s transmitted land laws distinguish a debtor’s compulsory service from automatic service by a spouse or children in the case described (Liaw §§43.8, 44.1; port-labour.md §3)
inference: Repayment could end bondage, but the sources give no particular account ledger or 1511 pay rate (port-labour.md §3; Liaw p. 41; Fujitani pp. 145–148)
gameplay: Kannan, his patron and the disputed repayment are fiction, not a staffing purchase (port-labour.md §4)
